ZWE.note: Satellite imagery is used to show property boundaries, not for crop or farming monitoring.

facts.fact: The Herald reports that over one million properties, more than 80% of an estimated 1.3 to 1.4 million, have been captured in the Ministry of Lands' new electronic land administration system, the One National e-Cadastre, with integration with the Deeds Office and ZIMRA still to come and an official launch targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands and Rural Development

facts.fact: The Herald reports that Zimbabwe's One National e-Cadastre has recorded over 80% of an estimated 1.3 to 1.4 million property records, with spatial digitisation covering roughly 60% of the country; the official launch is targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

The Herald reports that the e-Cadastre's mobile-compatible public platform lets users at home and abroad search farms, mining leases and properties, view mapped boundaries and retrieve over 100,000 digitised survey diagrams without visiting offices.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands and Rural Development
